title: Senthamizh Paattu
desc: Despite his mother's objection to singing songs, Bala develops an interest in music. He falls in love with Durga, a rich girl with whose family his mother's miseries are interlinked.

title: Asuran
desc: Amidst the chaos of a criminal constantly evading the police and a woman's love affair with an agricultural officer, something sinister brews that affects everyone's life.

title: Kuppathu Raja
desc: Selvam, a taxi driver, is on a mission to seek revenge on a person. Little does he know that Raja, with whom he has a budding friendship, is the person he dislikes.

title: Sattam En Kaiyil
desc: Separated at a young age, twin brothers encounter each other after growing up, and their similar appearance creates confusion for their respective love interests.

title: Karuppu Nila
desc: After his father is falsely accused of aiding terrorists, Shanmuga Pandian's girlfriend leaves him. However, he joins forces with Nandhini and battles against all odds to clear his father's name.
